harvest.intro: You’ve surely already poured a lot of yourself elsewhere — into another AI, across conversations. Copy one of these prompts, paste it to your AI, then bring its answer back here. Dream isn’t a silo: it’s a hearth where all your inner material can come together.
harvest.pasteHint: Copy your AI’s answer, come back here and paste it into the paste box — mark it “a moment of the day” so it joins your waking voice.

prompts.title: What I’m facing right now
prompts.prompt: Read back over our recent exchanges and list what I’m going through right now: my challenges, the decisions ahead of me, my fears, my impulses. Write one line per item, in my own words, without rephrasing or embellishing. Separate each item with a line containing only ---.

prompts.title: My doubts and questions
prompts.prompt: Read back over our conversations and gather the doubts and questions I carry, even the ones I never named clearly. One line per doubt or question, in my own language. Separate each item with a line containing only ---.

prompts.title: Messages from my heart
prompts.prompt: Pick out the moments when I spoke to you from the heart: what moves me, what I love, what hurts me, what I hold dear. Give them back as I said them, one per line. Separate each item with a line containing only ---.

prompts.title: What I’ve learned about myself
prompts.prompt: From everything we’ve exchanged, list what I’ve discovered or understood about myself: how I work, what I need, the patterns that keep returning. One realization per line, in my words. Separate each item with a line containing only ---.

prompts.title: My recurring intuitions
prompts.prompt: Spot the intuitions, hunches and ideas that come up often in our exchanges. List them plainly, one per line, without interpreting them. Separate each item with a line containing only ---.
